about.title: Locally owned in Oregon City
paragraphs: At Elliott Painting Inc, we take pride in bringing color and craftsmanship to homes and businesses in NW Oregon. As an Oregon City locally owned painting and construction company, we are dedicated to delivering high-quality workmanship with a personal touch.

Our skilled team specializes in interior and exterior painting, drywall repair, cabinet refinishing, carpentry, epoxy and pressure washing. We use premium materials and proven techniques to ensure a flawless finish that stands the test of time.

We believe in building lasting relationships with our clients by providing reliable service, transparent communication, and results that exceed expectations. When you choose Elliott Painting, you are supporting a business that values quality, integrity, and the local community.

estimate.title: Let's bring your vision to life.
estimate.text: Tell us about your project and we'll get back to you with a free estimate. We stay in constant communication with our customers until the job is done.
estimate.thanks: We got your request and will reach out soon to set up your free estimate.

services.name: Exterior Painting
services.blurb: Siding, trim and doors, with careful prep for a finish that stands the test of time.
services.intro: Exterior painting for homes and businesses in Oregon City and across NW Oregon. We use premium materials and proven techniques to ensure a flawless finish that stands the test of time.
includes: Front doors, garage doors and shutters
Surface prep: washing, scraping, sanding, caulking and priming
photos: Modern white home with black trim

services.name: Interior Painting
services.blurb: Walls, ceilings and trim, from a single room to an entire property.
services.intro: Whether you are refreshing a single room or transforming an entire property, we bring the same professionalism and attention to detail to every interior.
includes: Furniture and floors protected while we work
Clean lines and a thorough cleanup

services.name: Cabinet Refinishing
services.blurb: Turn dated wood cabinets into a bright, modern kitchen without replacing them.
services.intro: Cabinet refinishing gives your kitchen a whole new look for a fraction of the cost of new cabinets. See the before and after below.
includes: Cleaning, sanding and priming for a durable finish

services.name: Drywall Repair
services.blurb: Holes, cracks and damaged sections patched smooth and ready for paint.
services.intro: From small holes to damaged sections, we repair drywall so it blends in with the rest of the wall, then finish it with paint.
includes: Texture matched to the surrounding wall
Primed and painted to blend in

services.name: Carpentry
services.blurb: Trim, repairs and small construction projects around your home or business.
services.intro: As a painting and construction company, we handle the carpentry that often comes before a great paint job, along with small projects around your property.
includes: Rotted wood and siding repair before painting

services.name: Epoxy Floors
services.blurb: Tough, easy-to-clean epoxy coatings for garages and shops.
services.intro: Epoxy coatings turn bare concrete into a durable, easy-to-clean floor for garages, shops and commercial spaces.
includes: A finished floor that is easy to keep clean

services.name: Pressure Washing
services.blurb: Siding, decks, driveways and patios cleaned, before paint or just to refresh.
services.intro: Pressure washing brings back siding, decks and concrete, and it is the first step of every exterior paint job.
photos: Patio and walkway after pressure washing
